question: According to the census of India 2011, what is the female literacy rate in Dadra and Nagar Haveli?
solution:
The correct answer is __**64.32%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the female literacy rate in Dadra and Nagar Haveli is** 64.32%.**
 
• The overall literacy rate in Dadra and Nagar Haveli was recorded at **76.2%** during the same census period.
 
• The male literacy rate in the region was significantly higher, standing at **85.17%**.
 
• Dadra and Nagar Haveli is a Union Territory in western India, known for its tribal population and diverse cultural heritage.
 
• The census data is crucial for understanding demographic trends and planning educational and social programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate:**

 
 
• Literacy rate refers to the percentage of people who can read and write in a specific population aged seven years and above.
 
• It is a crucial indicator of educational attainment and socio-economic development.
 
 
 
• **Census of India:**
 
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on population, socio-economic characteristics, and other vital statistics.
 
 
 
• **Union Territories:**
 
 
• Union Territories are regions governed directly by the Central Government of India.
 
• They have a different administrative setup compared to states, often with a Lieutenant Governor as the administrative head.
 
 
 
• **Educational Programs:**
 
 
• Government initiatives aimed at improving literacy rates include schemes like Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan and Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.
 
• These programs focus on providing universal access to education and promoting gender equality in educational opportunities.
